Environment variables ​

Unset = the safe default. Every hardening feature is opt-in; every write flag must equal the literal string "true"; stores fall back with a warning rather than failing boot.

Model chain (LLM_*) ​

VariableMeaning
LLM_CHAINOrdered endpoint names, e.g. openai,anthropic, ollama, mock. Unset ⇒ legacy single provider (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / LLM_API_BASE+LLM_MODEL) or the mock.
LLM_<NAME>_PRESETReuse a preset under another name (two models of one provider). Presets: anthropic, mock, openai, ollama, vllm, llamacpp, lmstudio, fireworks, together, deepseek, gemini, groq, mistral, openrouter.
LLM_<NAME>_BASE / _MODEL / _API_KEYThe endpoint. Local bases need no key.
LLM_<NAME>_TEMPERATUREnumber or none (omit the field).
LLM_<NAME>_REASONING_EFFORTlow/medium/high/none/omit.
LLM_<NAME>_BODYJSON merged into every request (null removes a preset field).
LLM_<NAME>_PRICEinput,cached,output[,cache_write] USD per million.
LLM_<NAME>_NOTESPer-model notes file (none to disable); default shared-skills/model-notes/<slug>.md.
LLM_<NAME>_AUTH_HEADERSend the key in this header instead of Authorization: Bearer.
LLM_FAILOVER_THRESHOLD (2), LLM_FAILOVER_COOLDOWN_S (60), LLM_RETRIES (2), LLM_RETRY_MAX_WAIT_MS (20000), LLM_TIMEOUT_MS (120000)Breaker and retries.
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_MODELThe anthropic preset.
AGENT_ROUTER_MODEL, AGENT_ROUTER_MIN_CONFIDENCE (0.35)Routing hop.

Typed decisions (VERDICT_*) ​

VERDICT_SYSTEMONE_URL, VERDICT_SYSTEMONE_MODEL (laya), VERDICT_SYSTEMONE_API_KEY, VERDICT_MIN_CONFIDENCE (0.6), VERDICT_ESCALATE_BELOW (0.5), VERDICT_LLM (off disables the LLM link).

Safety and identity (AGENT_*) ​

VariableDefaultMeaning
AGENT_ALLOW_WRITESunset (off)Real writes only when literally true.
AGENT_REQUIRE_LOGINonfalse only for dev/evals/probe.
AGENT_AUTH_VERIFY_URL—Strict identity verification endpoint (GET with the bearer).
AGENT_TOKEN_SECRET, AGENT_TOKEN_TTL_S (900), AGENT_APP_KEYS (key:tenant,…)—The agent-token exchange.
AGENT_ENTITLEMENT_URL, AGENT_ENTITLEMENT_KEY—Seats and caps at exchange.
AGENT_GATEWAY_KEYS, AGENT_ADMIN_KEY, AGENT_CORS_ORIGINS, AGENT_TRUST_PROXY, AGENT_MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS (4000), AGENT_LINK_SCHEMES—Gateway hardening.
AGENT_GUARDSonfalse disables the runtime guards (raw-model evals only).
AGENT_TYPED_PROMPTonfalse loads every type's skill and tools.

Limits and cost ​

AGENT_RATE_SESSIONS_PER_IP (20), AGENT_RATE_CHAT_PER_SESSION (10), AGENT_RATE_CHAT_PER_IP (60), AGENT_RATE_TRANSCRIBE_PER_IP (30), AGENT_RATE_MEDIA_PER_IP (60), AGENT_RATE_MAX_CONCURRENT (8), AGENT_RATE_DISABLED; AGENT_CAP_TOKENS_PER_SESSION, _5H, _DAY, _WEEK, _MONTH, AGENT_CAP_CONTEXT_TOKENS, AGENT_CAP_TZ_OFFSET_MIN; AGENT_PLAN_WEIGHT_INPUT/CACHED/OUTPUT/CACHE_WRITE; AGENT_TOOL_RESULT_MAX_CHARS (12000), AGENT_TOOL_RESULT_KEEP_CHARS (1500), AGENT_TRIM_TOOL_HISTORY_TURNS (2); AGENT_MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS (10); AGENT_MAX_HISTORY_MESSAGES (60); AGENT_SESSION_CACHE (2000).

Stores, sessions, retention ​

AGENT_REDIS_URL, AGENT_MONGO_URL, AGENT_MONGO_DB (marg), AGENT_SESSION_DIR (.sessions), AGENT_SESSION_RETENTION_DAYS, AGENT_LEDGER_DIR (.data/ledger).

Channels ​

DEEPGRAM_API_KEY or AGENT_STT_PROVIDER=openai + AGENT_STT_BASE + AGENT_STT_API_KEY, AGENT_STT_MODEL, AGENT_STT_LANGUAGE, AGENT_STT_KEYWORDS, AGENT_STT_PRICE_PER_MIN; AGENT_MEDIA_DOMAIN, AGENT_FILE_BASE, AGENT_MEDIA_MAX_IMAGE_MB (15), _FILE_MB (25), _VIDEO_MB (128), AGENT_MEDIA_MAX_ITEMS (30); AGENT_ENTITY_DEEPLINK, AGENT_UPLOAD_DEEPLINK ({entity_id} templates); AGENT_NUDGE_ENABLED, AGENT_NUDGE_MAX (3), AGENT_NUDGE_INTERVAL_MS (300000), AGENT_NUDGE_LINES.

Observability and logs ​

AGENT_O2_URL, AGENT_O2_ORG (default), AGENT_O2_USER, AGENT_O2_PASSWORD or AGENT_O2_TOKEN, AGENT_O2_LOG_STREAM, AGENT_O2_LOGS (off), OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS, OTEL_SERVICE_NAME, OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG, AGENT_OTEL (off), AGENT_OTEL_CAPTURE_CONTENT (heads), AGENT_OTEL_METRICS_INTERVAL_MS (15000); LOG_LEVEL, AGENT_TRACE (off), AGENT_LOG_DIR, AGENT_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS (14), AGENT_LOG_STDOUT, AGENT_LOG_SYNC, AGENT_LOG_TO_STDERR, AGENT_REDACT_KEYS, AGENT_REDACT_PHONES; AGENT_ALERT_ERROR_RATIO (0.5), AGENT_ALERT_WEBHOOK.

Metering ​

AGENT_METERING_URL, AGENT_METERING_API_KEY, AGENT_METERING_PRODUCT (agent).

Process ​

GATEWAY_PORT (8787), AGENT_BRAND (Marg), AGENT_SERVICE_NAMESPACE (marg), AGENT_METRIC_PREFIX (agent), AGENT_ENV (local), AGENT_DOMAIN_DIRS (domains,examples), AGENT_DOMAINS (all), AGENT_PUBLIC_DIR, AGENT_WIDGET_FILE, AGENT_SHARED_SKILLS_DIR, AGENT_REPO_ROOT, AGENT_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_MS (10000). AGENT_REPO_ROOT defaults to the repository root when running from a checkout and to the working directory's project (the nearest package.json or .git) when the packages are installed from npm; .env, domains/, examples/ and shared-skills/ are read from there.

Evals ​

EVAL_GATEWAY (http://localhost:8788), SCENARIO, EVAL_SHARD (i/n), EVAL_RERUNS, EVAL_FLAKES, EVAL_VERBOSE, EVAL_BEARER.
